description: Hand-written responses for case data-loss-migration, used to test the evaluation harness offline (pnpm eval --provider fake --recorded). They were not produced by a model and say nothing about any model's review quality; record real ones with pnpm eval --record.

findings.title: Dropping users.email loses every address: nothing copies it to contact_email
findings.description: contact_email is added empty and email is dropped in the next statement; no UPDATE copies the data, and the NOT NULL constraint then fails on existing rows.
findings.impact: Irreversible loss of all user email addresses (or a failed deploy).

evidence.snippet: ALTER TABLE users DROP COLUMN email;
evidence.why: The column is dropped right after an empty column is added.

findings.suggestedFix: Use ALTER TABLE users RENAME COLUMN email TO contact_email, or backfill with UPDATE users SET contact_email = email before dropping.

reasons: Scripted verdict: the cited code shows the problem.

summary.overview: Scripted summary for the evaluation harness (not produced by a model).
